THE EARLY HOURS AT THE WHITE HOUSE THE ATTENDANTS ON THE SUFFERER. A GOOD OMEN. MORE JOYFUL NEWS. SOME UNFAVORABLE SYMPTOMS. GLOOMY FOREBODINGS.
stories.summary: WASHINGTON,.--The feeling in this city has changed within the past 24 hours from that of the utmost alarm to one of hope and joy.

stories.summary: Midnight.--There has been a marked improvement in the condition of the President since 9 o'clock. Previous to that hour there were indications of a rapid decline, and to an extent that alarmed the physicians.
